findings.current: A few days earlier, after I had sentenced him to the Yangtze-dipping punishment, Hyuk Mujin had immediately logged out. As a result, he had spent an entire shichen sightseeing at the Yangtze Aquarium.
findings.defect: The draft reverses the subject of the Logout action. Taekyung logged out after imposing the punishment; Hyuk Mujin remained behind in the Yangtze for a full shichen.
findings.rationale: The explicit subject of 로그아웃한 is 내가, and 덕분에 causally connects Taekyung’s departure to Hyuk Mujin’s prolonged punishment.
findings.replacement: A few days earlier, after sentencing him to the Yangtze-dipping punishment, I had immediately logged out, leaving Hyuk Mujin to spend an entire shichen sightseeing at the Yangtze Aquarium.
findings.source: 며칠 전, 내가 장강 찍먹 형벌을 내린 뒤 곧바로 로그아웃한 덕분에 장장 한 시진 동안 장강 아쿠아리움을 구경한 혁무진이다.

findings.current: The Blood Lord’s recovery from Jeok Cheongang’s Dance of the Fire God and Demon had made him look less like a human and more like a Troll.
findings.defect: The draft changes the comparison from the Blood Lord’s Troll-like manner of recovering to his recovery altering his appearance.
findings.rationale: 회복하는 모습 describes what his regeneration looked like; it does not say that recovering made his physical appearance Troll-like.
findings.replacement: The way the Blood Lord recovered from Jeok Cheongang’s Dance of the Fire God and Demon was like that of a Troll, not a human.
findings.source: 적천강이 펼친 화신귀무에서 회복하는 혈주의 모습은 인간이 아닌 트롤과도 같았고,

findings.current: The Lord of Heaven worshiped by the Western Heaven Demon Lord had appeared before us by borrowing the body of a subordinate whose life had already ended.
findings.defect: The draft changes the participant from Taekyung alone to an unspecified group by rendering 나와 as “us.”
findings.rationale: 나와 마주했다 explicitly means that the Lord of Heaven faced or encountered the first-person narrator.
findings.replacement: The Lord of Heaven worshiped by the Western Heaven Demon Lord had appeared before me by borrowing the body of a subordinate who was already dead.
findings.source: 서천마군이 숭배해 마지않던 암천의 천주(天主)는 이미 숨이 끊긴 수하의 몸을 빌려 나와 마주했다.

findings.current: I knew nothing about how strange or vast the martial arts of the demonic, heterodox arts were—the arts Murim called demonic martial arts.
findings.defect: The phrase “martial arts of the demonic, heterodox arts” is grammatically malformed and reverses the terminology relationship: Murim describes them as demonic and heterodox, while people commonly call them demonic martial arts.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves 사마외도 as the broader Murim classification and 마공 as the common name without the nested, nonsensical construction.
findings.replacement: The martial arts of those Murim deemed demonic and heterodox—what people commonly called demonic martial arts. I had no idea how bizarre or far-ranging they could be.
findings.source: 무림에서 말하는 사마외도(邪魔外道)의 무공. 흔히들 마공(魔功)이라 부르는 그것이 얼마나 괴이하며 광활한지 나는 모른다.

findings.current: That was not the only reason. A short distance away, Mungyeong was watching us while stroking his large acupuncture needle with ominous intent.
findings.defect: The draft omits the explicit distance of several jang and makes Mungyeong’s suggestive gesture explicitly ominous, adding an interpretation absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 몇 장 gives a concrete distance, while 의미심장하게 characterizes the gesture as pointed or suggestive rather than directly stating hostile intent.
findings.replacement: It wasn’t only because I saw Mungyeong several jang away, watching us as he pointedly stroked a large acupuncture needle.
findings.source: 몇 장 떨어진 곳에서 이쪽을 바라보며 의미심장하게 대침을 쓰다듬는 문경의 모습을 봤기 때문만은 아니다.

findings.defect: The quotation marks incorrectly present the action sound effects as spoken dialogue.
findings.rationale: The Korean is unspoken action onomatopoeia accompanying Taekyung’s sudden grab and throw.

findings.defect: The draft applies the established transliteration for 시부럴 to the distinct shortened profanity 시벌, producing unnatural mixed English.
findings.rationale: 시벌 is a forceful expletive here, while the binding temporary rendering specifically applies “sibu-leol” to 시부럴.

summary: The draft contains one reversed subject, two altered action/participant details, and several localized terminology and prose issues.
